list.title: Experiments
list.description: Hypotheses running on your flags, and whether they are winning.
list.guardrailWorse: A guardrail metric got significantly worse

emptyState.title: Test a change before everyone gets it
emptyState.description: An experiment takes over one of your flags, splits users into variations and tells you which one moves your metric.

flag.title: Flag
flag.body: Ship the change behind a flag.

experiment.title: Experiment
experiment.body: Register the hypothesis, split and primary metric.

exposures.title: Exposures
exposures.body: The SDK logs who saw which variation.

results.title: Results
results.body: Decide to ship or roll back with trustworthy stats.

new.title: New experiment
new.description: Name it, pick the flag and the metric that decides. Everything else starts from sensible defaults you can adjust on the next page. Nothing goes live until you start it.

create.name: Name
create.nameHelp: What you're testing, in plain words. Shown in lists and results.
create.primaryHelp: The metric that decides ship or roll back. Needed to start; you can also set it later.
create.note: Creates a draft. Nothing changes for users until you start it, and every default can be changed on the next page.
create.defaultsBoolean: Defaults: control serves {{control}} and treatment {{treatment}}, split evenly across everyone in {{environments}}. All of it can be changed on the next page.
create.defaultsOther: Defaults: control serves the flag's default {{control}}, split evenly with one treatment across everyone in {{environments}}. You set the treatment's value on the next page.

newMetric.title: New metric
newMetric.description: Counts an event your app already sends with track(). Filters, windows and capping can be refined on the metric's page later.
newMetric.eventHelp: The name sent with track(). Recent events are suggested.
newMetric.eventHelpSum: The name sent with track(name, value); values are summed per user.
newMetric.eventHelpValue: The name sent with track(name, value); values are averaged per event.
newMetric.noEvents: No events in the last 30 days. Type the name your app will send.
newMetric.name: Name
newMetric.nameHelp: Filled in from the event. The key follows the name.

sections.advancedDescription: The defaults suit most experiments. Change one only when its note applies.

summary.guardrailsHint: A guardrail catches a treatment that wins on the primary but breaks something else.
summary.hypothesisHint: Writing down what you expect before the data arrives keeps the result from changing the question.
summary.planHint: Estimates how long to run from the baseline and daily users, filled in from real data where possible.
summary.breakdownsHint: Set when you want results split by an attribute such as country or plan. Locks at start.
summary.namespaceDefault: Default: users can also be in other experiments
summary.namespaceHint: Set when another experiment changes the same screen at the same time, so nobody sees both.
summary.statsHint: Fine for most experiments. Change only to follow a team policy (e.g. 99% confidence). Locks at start.

help.primary: The single metric that decides ship or roll back, chosen before the data arrives so the decision can't be cherry-picked.
help.guardrail: A metric that must not get worse, such as errors, latency or unsubscribes. A significant regression is flagged next to any winning result.
help.metrics: The primary decides, guardrails protect, secondary metrics explain. Only the primary is required.
help.hashAttribute: The user attribute hashed to pick a variation, usually the user id. Use a device or company id to keep a whole device or account in one variation.
help.plan: Power analysis: how many users each variation needs to detect the minimum detectable effect (MDE) with 80% power. Smaller effects need more users.
help.namespace: Experiments in the same namespace take separate slices of users, so nobody is in two of them at once.

plan.noPrimary: Choose a primary metric to plan against.
plan.loading: Reading the last 28 days of data…
plan.fromData_one: Filled in from the last {{count}} day in {{environment}} ({{users}} users). Adjust if you expect different traffic.
plan.fromData_other: Filled in from the last {{count}} days in {{environment}} ({{users}} users). Adjust if you expect different traffic.
plan.noData: No events in {{environment}} yet; enter today's values.
plan.warehouse: Warehouse metrics aren't read automatically; enter today's values.
plan.ratio: Ratio metrics aren't read automatically; enter the mean and standard deviation.
plan.long_one: This plan needs about {{count}} day, more than 6 weeks.
plan.long_other: This plan needs about {{count}} days, more than 6 weeks.
plan.longSuggest: Long experiments drift with seasonality and returning users. Aim for a larger effect to finish sooner:
plan.longNoSuggest: Long experiments drift with seasonality and returning users. Raise the coverage or the MDE to finish sooner.

checks.title: Before you start
checks.sameValue: A treatment serves the same value as control. Change it unless this is an A/A test
checks.flagOff: The flag is off in {{environments}}: nobody there is assigned
checks.guardrail: Add a guardrail metric to catch side effects

toast.startedDescription: Users are being assigned. Results appear as exposures arrive.

start.title: Start {{name}}?
start.body_one: The experiment rule on {{flag}} goes live in 1 environment ({{environments}}). Matching users are assigned to {{variations}} from now on.
start.body_other: The experiment rule on {{flag}} goes live in {{count}} environments ({{environments}}). Matching users are assigned to {{variations}} from now on.
start.locks: Variations and statistics settings lock so the result can't be tuned after the fact.
start.flagOff: {{flag}} is off in {{environments}}: nobody there is assigned until you turn the flag on.
start.needsPrimary: Set a primary metric first (Setup → Metrics). Starting without one is not allowed.

delete.title: Delete this draft?
delete.body: {{name}} and its rule on {{flag}} are removed. Nobody was assigned yet, so no data is lost.

hypothesis.name: Name
hypothesis.keyHelp: Sent with every exposure. Can't change later.
hypothesis.hypothesisPlaceholder: If we collapse checkout into one page, then more visitors will complete a purchase, because fewer steps means fewer chances to drop off.
hypothesis.hypothesisHelp: Written before the data arrives, so the result can't change what you were testing.

flag.label: Flag
flag.noFlags: No flags yet. <link>Create a flag</link> first; the experiment serves its values.
flag.error: Choose the flag this experiment runs on.
flag.help: The experiment adds a rule to this flag and serves one of its values per variation.
flag.sameValue: Same value as {{name}}: this arm is an A/A check.

traffic.coverageHelp: Share of matching users who enter; the rest get the flag's other rules. You can raise it later without restarting.
traffic.environmentsHelp: The experiment rule is added to the flag in each.
traffic.analyzeHelp: Usually production; other environments are for QA.
traffic.assignByHelp: Users with the same value always get the same variation.

metrics.primaryHelp: The one metric that decides ship or roll back. Required to start.
metrics.noMetricsInline: No metrics yet. Create one below without leaving this page.
metrics.guardrailsHelp: Must not get worse, e.g. errors or latency.

plan.baselineRateHelp: Today's rate of the primary metric.
plan.dailyUsersHelp: Users who evaluate the flag and match the targeting.
plan.minWeek: Run at least 7 days to cover weekly cycles.
plan.in14Days: In 14 days you could detect a <value>{{mde}}</value> lift.
plan.fillIn: Fill in the baseline and traffic to see the sample size.
plan.assumptions: 80% power, fixed horizon. The planned total also tunes the sequential test.

stats.bayesianHelp: Chance to win and credible intervals.
stats.sequentialHelp: Intervals stay valid however often you check results. Keep it on unless you will look exactly once.
stats.cupedHelp: Uses each user's behavior in the 14 days before exposure to shrink intervals, so you need fewer users.
stats.holmHelp: Adjusts p-values when several metrics and variations are compared, to keep false wins rare.
stats.confidenceHelp: A higher level means fewer false wins but needs more users.

breakdowns.title: Breakdowns
breakdowns.description: Attributes to split results by. The SDK sends their values with each exposure, so only users exposed after the experiment starts are covered. Choose them now: they lock once it starts.
breakdowns.warehouse: With a warehouse data source, the exposure SQL needs a column with the same name instead.

traffic.title: Change traffic
traffic.description: Phase {{phase}} is running. Raising coverage is safe; anything else re-randomizes users.
traffic.coverageHelp: Now {{percent}}%. Raising it keeps the phase.
traffic.newPhase: This starts phase {{phase}} and re-randomizes users; results restart.
traffic.newPhaseWhy: Because {{changes}}, keeping users in place would bias the comparison. Phase {{current}}'s data stays in the record but is no longer analyzed.
traffic.keepsPhase: Coverage increase keeps the current phase.
traffic.keepsPhaseWhy: Users already in the experiment keep their variation; new users join at the same split.
traffic.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Treatment had a checkout bug in Safari; fixed in 2.4.1
traffic.reasonHelp: Shown on the phase timeline and in History.

stop.title: Stop & decide
stop.description: Stopping ends assignment and records the decision. It can't be undone; a new experiment is needed to test again.
stop.shipHelp: Roll this variation out to everyone in the experiment.
stop.rollbackHelp: Remove the change; keep what users had before.
stop.inconclusiveHelp: No clear answer. Remove the rule and record it.
stop.shipSummary: The flag will serve {{name}}'s value <value/> to everyone matching the targeting in {{environments}}. The experiment rule becomes a fixed rule you can edit on the flag later.
stop.removeSummary: The experiment rule is removed from {{flag}} in {{environments}}. Users get the flag's other rules or its default value .
stop.removeSummaryNoValue: The experiment rule is removed from {{flag}} in {{environments}}. Users get the flag's other rules or its default value.
stop.recordedInconclusive: The decision is recorded as inconclusive.
stop.whyPlaceholder: e.g. +4.2% checkout conversion [+1.1%, +7.3%], guardrails flat, health OK after 14 days
stop.whyHelp: Kept with the experiment so the team can find out later what was decided and why.

setup.locked: Locked at start so results can't be re-run until they look good

phases.intro: Changing weights, targeting or lowering coverage starts a new phase with a new seed, so every user is re-assigned. Results only use the current phase.
